pinyin: méi mao hú zi yī bǎ zhuā
natural: handle everything at once without priorities

meaning.en: To tackle everything at once without sorting out priorities.
meaning.zh: 比喻做事不分轻重主次，一齐抓。

equivalents: try to do everything at once

examples.zh: 工作要分清主次，不能眉毛胡子一把抓。
examples.en: Set priorities at work; don't try to grab everything at once.

examples.zh: 他安排任务总是眉毛胡子一把抓。
examples.en: He always assigns tasks with no sense of priority.

usage.en: Predicate; usually 不能/别…眉毛胡子一把抓.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“不能眉毛胡子一把抓”。

meaning.en: Pulling at each other; also being over-familiar or bound up in improper ties.
meaning.zh: 互相拉扯；也指关系不正当或不清不楚。

examples.zh: 两个孩子在门口拉拉扯扯。
examples.en: The two children were tugging at each other by the door.

examples.zh: 工作中不要和客户拉拉扯扯。
examples.en: Don't get overly familiar with clients at work.

meaning.en: Dull and uninteresting.
meaning.zh: 单调，没有趣味。

examples.zh: 这节课枯燥无味，大家都在打哈欠。
examples.en: The lesson was dull and everyone was yawning.

examples.zh: 他的发言枯燥无味。
examples.en: His speech was dry as dust.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also 枯燥乏味.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；也作“枯燥乏味”。

meaning.en: To meet again after a long separation.
meaning.zh: 分别很久后又重新见面。

equivalents: meet again after a long time

examples.zh: 老同学久别重逢，格外高兴。
examples.en: Old classmates meeting again after years were especially happy.

examples.zh: 这对姐妹久别重逢，抱头痛哭。
examples.en: The sisters, reunited after long years, hugged and wept.

meaning.en: To talk in general terms without going into specifics.
meaning.zh: 只作一般的谈论，不深入具体。

examples.zh: 发言不能泛泛而谈，要有具体数据。
examples.en: Don't speak in generalities; give specific data.

examples.zh: 他只是泛泛而谈，没有提出办法。
examples.en: He only spoke in broad terms and offered no solution.

meaning.en: Illicit speculation and profiteering by buying cheap and selling dear.
meaning.zh: 利用时机牟取暴利的非法买卖行为。

examples.zh: 在计划经济年代，投机倒把是违法的。
examples.en: In the planned-economy era, profiteering was illegal.

examples.zh: 他靠投机倒把发了一笔横财。
examples.en: He made a windfall by speculating.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，带有历史和法律色彩。

meaning.en: Bizarre, unreasonable statements and theories.
meaning.zh: 离奇古怪、不合情理的言论。

examples.zh: 网上充斥着各种奇谈怪论。
examples.en: The internet is full of outlandish claims.

examples.zh: 别信这些奇谈怪论。
examples.en: Don't believe these crackpot theories.

literal: waist · wrapped · ten-thousand · strings of cash

meaning.en: Extremely wealthy.
meaning.zh: 形容非常有钱。

examples.zh: 他如今已是腰缠万贯的富商。
examples.en: He's now a filthy-rich merchant.

examples.zh: 腰缠万贯也买不到健康。
examples.en: Even great wealth can't buy health.

meaning.en: When hungry, one is not picky; also, in dire need one will take whatever offers.
meaning.zh: 饿急了，顾不得挑选食物；比喻急需时顾不上选择。

examples.zh: 他饿坏了，饥不择食，什么都吃。
examples.en: He was starving and ate anything.

examples.zh: 急着找工作，难免饥不择食。
examples.en: Desperate for work, one can't help taking whatever comes.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 寒不择衣.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“寒不择衣”连用。

natural: teaching and learning benefit each other

meaning.en: Teaching and learning promote each other.
meaning.zh: 教和学互相促进，共同提高。

equivalents: teaching and learning go hand in hand

examples.zh: 教学相长，我在辅导学生时也学到不少。
examples.en: Teaching and learning benefit each other; tutoring students has taught me a lot.

examples.zh: 老师与学生之间应当教学相长。
examples.en: Teachers and students should grow together.

story.en: 'Only after learning do you know your shortcomings; only after teaching do you know your difficulties... hence teaching and learning grow together' (故曰教学相长也).
story.zh: 《礼记·学记》：“学然后知不足，教然后知困……故曰教学相长也。”

meaning.en: To meet with setbacks at the very start of an undertaking.
meaning.zh: 出兵不顺利；泛指事情一开始就遇到挫折。

equivalents: get off to a bad start

examples.zh: 球队首场比赛就输了，可谓出师不利。
examples.en: The team lost its first game, a bad start indeed.

examples.zh: 新店开业就遇上暴雨，出师不利。
examples.en: The new shop opened in a downpour: an unlucky start.

meaning.en: Stars cradling the moon: a person surrounded and admired by many.
meaning.zh: 许多星星簇拥着月亮，比喻众人围绕、拥戴一个中心人物。

examples.zh: 她像众星捧月一样被粉丝围在中间。
examples.en: She stood surrounded by her fans like the moon among the stars.

examples.zh: 新娘在亲友的簇拥下，众星捧月般走进礼堂。
examples.en: The bride entered the hall, cradled by relatives like the moon among stars.

natural: glimpse a part of the whole

meaning.en: To glimpse a part and so infer the whole.
meaning.zh: 从所见的局部推知全貌。

equivalents: get a glimpse of the whole
infer the whole from a part

examples.zh: 从这件小事可以窥见一斑。
examples.en: From this small matter one can glimpse the whole.

examples.zh: 这个展览让人窥见一斑，了解了古代的生活。
examples.en: The exhibition offers a glimpse into ancient life.

usage.en: Predicate; from 管中窥豹，可见一斑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，出自“管中窥豹，可见一斑”。

meaning.en: Entirely true and certain.
meaning.zh: 非常真实，一点不假。

examples.zh: 这事千真万确，我亲眼所见。
examples.en: It's absolutely true; I saw it with my own eyes.

examples.zh: 他说的话千真万确。
examples.en: What he said is the plain truth.

meaning.en: To get straight to the point without beating about the bush.
meaning.zh: 比喻说话直截了当，不绕弯子。

examples.zh: 他单刀直入地问：你到底想要什么？
examples.en: He asked bluntly: what do you actually want?

examples.zh: 谈判时，她单刀直入，提出了条件。
examples.en: In the negotiation, she cut straight to the chase and stated her terms.

meaning.en: Almost unable to contain one's joy.
meaning.zh: 快乐到了极点。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她乐不可支。
examples.en: She was overjoyed to hear the news.

examples.zh: 孩子们收到礼物，乐不可支。
examples.en: The children were thrilled to get presents.

meaning.en: Being courteous and friendly in business brings prosperity.
meaning.zh: 待人和气，生意才能兴隆。

examples.zh: 做生意要和气生财，别跟顾客吵架。
examples.en: In trade, courtesy pays; don't argue with customers.

examples.zh: 老板总说和气生财。
examples.en: The boss always says friendliness brings business.

natural: a prosperous people and a strong state

meaning.en: A wealthy populace and a powerful nation.
meaning.zh: 人民富裕，国家强盛。

examples.zh: 改革的目标是民富国强。
examples.en: The goal of reform is a prosperous people and a strong nation.

examples.zh: 只有民富国强，社会才能长治久安。
examples.en: Only with a prosperous people and a strong nation can society be stable.

meaning.en: To exhaust every scheme and calculation, often to no avail.
meaning.zh: 用尽心机和算计，常含徒劳之意。

examples.zh: 他机关算尽，最后还是一场空。
examples.en: He schemed every way he could and still ended with nothing.

examples.zh: 机关算尽太聪明，反误了卿卿性命。
examples.en: Over-scheming can cost you your own life.

meaning.en: Counting everything in at the very most.
meaning.zh: 把所有的都算上，也就这么多。

examples.zh: 满打满算，这个项目也就三个月。
examples.en: All told, the project is only three months.

examples.zh: 满打满算，我们才见过三次。
examples.en: Counting everything, we've only met three times.

usage.zh: 多放句首，强调数量不多。

meaning.en: Each side refusing to yield to the other.
meaning.zh: 双方都不肯让步。

examples.zh: 两人为这件事各不相让。
examples.en: The two refused to give way to each other over this.

examples.zh: 双方在价格上各不相让，谈判陷入僵局。
examples.en: Neither side would budge on price and the talks stalled.

meaning.en: Everywhere one looks; so abundant one only needs to bend down to pick it up.
meaning.zh: 一低头就能拾到，形容到处都是，非常多。

examples.zh: 在这个古镇，历史遗迹俯拾皆是。
examples.en: In this ancient town historic sites are everywhere.

examples.zh: 这类案例在生活中俯拾皆是。
examples.en: Such examples are everywhere in daily life.
